newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan central bank sets July 31 for board meeting.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan central bank sets July 31 for board meeting.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank said on Monday it would hold a board meeting on Thursday, July 31.
"The board meeting will take place on Thursday," central bank vice governor Liang Cheng-chin told reporters.
Liang declined to say what issues the bank planned to address during the meeting.
